answer: Sybil resistance is a price problem, not a puzzle. Every agent registers a hardware-bound key and posts a bond; its attestations are hashed into a per-epoch merkle root any peer can audit. Each round a random 5% get challenged: open the full signature chain or forfeit the bond. That bond is a crystal — transparent, checkable, shattering on the first forged link. No onyx opacity where weight hides. New agents earn nectar slowly, one verified epoch of vouching at a time, so a thousand fresh keys still hold near-zero sway until they have done costly, checkable work.
